info.title: AgenticChangeOps change request API
info.description: Local-only JSON API over the intake, approval, requirements drafting, design drafting and workflow capabilities. No authentication. Error bodies carry a code: invalid-body (400), validation-failed (400), invalid-identifier (400), invalid-host (400), not-found (404), no-draft (404), no-design-draft (404), route-not-found (404), method-not-allowed (405), conflict (409), no-step-due (409), body-too-large (413), unsupported-media-type (415), generation-failed (502, with only a category), drafting-not-configured (503), design-not-configured (503), unexpected-error (500).
